issues.problem: The noisy-human and designer results are presented without identifying their distributional and decision-policy assumptions. Unlike the general rational-human result, the noisy-human analysis uses Gaussian robot beliefs and a simple noisy-rationality policy (c20, c21), and the designer illustration assumes Gaussian customer preferences and Gaussian observation noise (c26). Calling these a modeled setting or modified game does not tell readers which assumptions constrain these conclusions.
issues.suggested_fix: State in the explanation that the noisy-human analysis uses Gaussian beliefs and a simple noisy-rationality policy, and that the designer illustration uses Gaussian customer preferences and Gaussian observation noise. Attach c20, c21 and c26 respectively; qualify the corresponding findings as results within those specified analyses.
